title: 第25章 比赛之外第26章 输人不输阵
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
苏醒拿着号码牌，跟着工作人员走进了一间标着“A-12”
的房间。
这个房间带着一股陈旧的尘土味，进门后，第一眼看见的就是一个铁栅栏。
透过铁栅栏可以看见栅栏之外，是一片开阔的沙地，场中零星散布着几个低矮的木台。
更远处，是层层升起的、如同古罗马斗兽场般的看台，看台上已经开始坐上观众了。
进门左手边的墙上，摆放着密密麻麻的武器，但是有些位置已经空了，转头看向右边，右边的靠墙的位置是一排长石凳，9个少年，手拿武器，坐成一排。
铁栅栏前有一张木椅，木椅上坐着一个中年人，他见苏醒走了进来，查看了一下苏醒的号码牌，安排他坐到了长石凳的最右边，也就是最后一个位置。
他站到一众少年前，清了清嗓子，开口道：“既然人已经到齐了，我最后宣布一下比赛规则。”
他从衣服里取出一页纸，照着内容念了起来。
其实他说的内容大家报名时已经知晓了，其实就两条：
一，比赛生死不论，直到一方认输，认输后胆敢攻击的，格杀当场。
二，不得使用自己的防具，装备，药水等等的外物，只能使用赛场提供的武器。
“为什么不能用自己装备？”
一个身材格外魁梧的少年忍不住抱怨，声音带着不满：
“我是重装战士！
没了铠甲和盾牌，我还算什么重装？这太不公平了！”
中年人眼皮都没抬一下，冷冷道：“觉得不公平，现在就可以滚蛋。”
他扫了一眼那少年，语气讥诮。
“真当自己是个人物了？不过是群菜鸡互啄罢了。
让你们全副武装地互砍，一场比赛要拖到什么时候？贵人们的时间金贵，没空看你们一刀一刀地磨蹭。”

他顿了顿，目光扫过所有少年，继续念道：“另外，今年总参赛人数247人，奖励圈前24名。
第24名，赏100金币——这是对你们勇气和实力的奖赏。”
“第23名200金。”
“……”
“第1名奖励职业武器一把，储物戒指一个。”
念完，他将纸张重新折好塞回口袋，用眼睛慢悠悠地扫过眼前一张张年轻却紧绷的脸。
“加油吧，少年们。”
他的语气听不出丝毫鼓励，反而像是完成了一项无聊的差事，“祝你们规则在身，武运昌隆。”
说完，他便不再理会这些少年，重新坐回他的木椅，闭上眼睛假寐起来。
苏醒微微侧头，观察坐在长石凳上的少年们，发现有人兴奋，有人颤抖，有人恐惧，有人淡然，不一而足。
随着时间的流逝，竞技场的观众越来越多，声音汇聚，变得越来越大，传入“A-12”
少年们的耳中，一种紧张的气氛在无声地蔓延。
话分两头，罗璇轩在下注窗口，把身上带来的银行卡全掏了出来，全部划给了赌场，换来了一张带有魔法防伪标记的赌票。
罗璇轩从窗口走开，看着手上的赌票，又抬头看了看下注窗口上方的的显示屏，“227号的实时赔率已经变成了3.73倍。”
他弹了弹手中的赌票，心里美滋滋的，他对苏醒有十足的信心，不枉他亲身教学。
他想着，其实当时应该让苏醒再摸得仔细些。
可是就在这时，“227号的实时赔率突然上升，4.1，4.5，5.2……”
content_en:
Su Xing took the number plate and followed the staff into a room marked "A-12"
room.
This room smelled of old dust. After entering the door, the first thing you saw was an iron fence.
Through the iron fence, you can see that beyond the fence is an open sandy land with a few low wooden platforms scattered here and there.
Further away, there are stands rising up layer by layer, like the Colosseum in ancient Rome, and spectators have begun to fill the stands.
There were densely packed weapons on the wall on the left side of the door, but some of the seats were empty. Turning to the right, I saw a row of long stone benches against the wall on the right, with nine teenagers sitting in a row, holding weapons in their hands.
There was a wooden chair in front of the iron fence. Sitting on the wooden chair was a middle-aged man. When he saw Su Xing come in, he checked Su Xing's number plate and arranged for him to sit on the rightmost side of the long stone bench, which was the last position.
He stood in front of a group of teenagers, cleared his throat, and said, "Now that everyone is here, I will finally announce the rules of the game."
He took out a page from his clothes and read according to the content.
In fact, everyone already knew what he said when signing up. There are actually only two items:
1. The game is life or death until one side admits defeat. Anyone who dares to attack after admitting defeat will be killed on the spot.
Second, you are not allowed to use your own armor, equipment, potions, etc., and can only use weapons provided by the venue.
"Why can't you use your own equipment?"
A particularly burly young man couldn't help complaining, his voice filled with dissatisfaction:
"I'm a heavy warrior!
Without armor and shield, what kind of armor am I? This is so unfair! "
The middle-aged man didn't even raise his eyelids and said coldly: "If you think it's unfair, you can get out now."
He glanced at the young man and said in a mocking tone.
"Do you really think you are a person? They are just a bunch of noobs pecking each other.
Let you all be fully armed and attack each other. How long will a game last? Your time is valuable, and I don't have time to watch you waste time on it. "
He paused, glanced at all the teenagers, and continued: "In addition, the total number of participants this year is 247, and the top 24 in the reward circle.
The 24th place will be rewarded with 100 gold coins - this is a reward for your courage and strength. "
"200 gold for 23rd place."
"..."
"The first place will be rewarded with a professional weapon and a storage ring."
After reading, he refolded the paper and stuffed it back into his pocket, slowly scanning the young but tense faces in front of him with his eyes.
"Come on, boys."
There was no hint of encouragement in his tone. Instead, he sounded like he had completed a boring errand, "I wish you good luck in martial arts and follow the rules."
After saying that, he ignored these teenagers, sat back on his wooden chair, closed his eyes and fell asleep.
Su Xing turned his head slightly and observed the teenagers sitting on the long stone bench. He found that some were excited, some were trembling, some were afraid, and some were indifferent.
As time passed and the number of spectators in the arena grew, the voices gathered and became louder and louder, incoming "A-12"
In the ears of the teenagers, a tense atmosphere spread silently.
After splitting the conversation, Luo Xuanxuan took out all the bank cards he had brought with him at the betting window and transferred them all to the casino in exchange for a gambling ticket with a magic anti-counterfeiting mark.
Luo Xuanxuan walked away from the window, looked at the gambling ticket in his hand, and then looked up at the display above the betting window, "The real-time odds of No. 227 have become 3.73 times."
He flicked the gambling ticket in his hand and felt happy. He had full confidence in Su Xing and it was worthy of his personal teaching.
He thought that Su Xing should have been allowed to touch it more carefully at that time.
But at this moment, "the real-time odds of No. 227 suddenly increased, 4.1, 4.5, 5.2..."
